title: Closed cup with cushion and wall transmission: passive isolation example (theory-only)
description: A 40 mm driver (Tymphany HPD-40N16PET00-32 record) in a closed over-ear cup on the IEC 60318-4 ear. Outside sound reaches the ear by three paths, each ending at 'ambient' so that isolation drives it: the pad leak, the whole cup assembly moving on its cushion (a 'shell' of piston profile between the front cavity and the outside), and the rear cup wall flexing (a 'shell' of plate profile between the rear cavity and the outside), which moves the diaphragm. Cup mass, cushion resonance and loss, and wall thickness, resonance and loss are illustrative estimates, not measured values. Run 'acoustilab isolation' on it for the insertion loss per path and 'acoustilab ir' for the impulse response.
